blocks.x: When it comes to travel basics, no one does them better (and more affordably!) than Gap. I, for one, have been living in my Poplin Easy Barrel pants, which are just as chic for the office as they are for a long flight. From sweat sets and cotton T-shirts to denim jackets and knit sweaters, the all-American retailer has everything you need to embrace back-to-school season and fall travel.

Gap has always been a shopping mall mainstay, but there have been some exciting collaborations that have put it back on the map in recent years, from Dôen and Zac Posen to Victoria Beckham and Harlem’s Fashion Row. But what I love most about shopping at Gap is that there’s almost always a sale. Below, find the very best Gap promo codes, coupons, and discounts to help you stock your summer wardrobe.
Get 15% off with this Gap promo code for email & text signup

When you sign up for emails and texts from Gap, you'll receive a promo code for 15% off regularly priced items. By signing up, you’ll also receive style news and promotional emails, and you can withdraw consent at any time. The offer is valid for first time registrants only.
Get up to 60% off—plus an additional 40% off at checkout—on Gap sale items without a promo code

Be sure to keep tabs on Gap's sales page, where you can score up to 60% off markdowns and, for a limited time, an additional 40% off at checkout on select items. I'm a big fan of barn jackets this season—this Gap version is currently marked down from $148 to $125—and I’ve also been eyeing these lace-trim crop tops to layer underneath. Men can save on the Relaxed Straight Trouser jeans, currently marked down to $35. Whether you’re looking to stock up on Pointelle Crew T-shirts or trying out some ’90s-style low-rise jeans, there’s no better time for a wardrobe upgrade. The markdowns apply to both men's and women's styles.
Encore members get exclusive benefits, including a 20% first order discount and free shipping

Become an Encore member to get discounts across the entire Gap family—which includes Athleta, Banana Republic, and Old Navy—plus benefits like free shipping, early access to sales, and VIP invites. The membership comes with three tiers:
Core: free; earn 5 points per $1 spent; perks like free shipping on $50+
Premier: when you spend $350+ a year; everything Core gets plus more, like extended returns
All-Access: exclusively for card members; everything Premier gets plus more, like 25 points per $1 spent

All tiers can earn points on purchases and use them to save on future ones, but some of the benefits of Premier include a birthday bonus and a Create Your Own Sale day, while All-Access members get 20% off on their first order plus first dibs on select collections and drops (hello Gap x Summer Fridays). Combine your membership perks with existing sales to make your savings go even further.
What to do if your Gap coupon code isn’t working

If your Gap coupon code isn't working, be sure to check for typos, extra spaces, or incorrect capitalization, as well as any terms and conditions. The 40–60% off sale, for instance, only applies to select sweats, denim, and T-shirts. You can also try clearing your browser’s cache and cookies, or switching devices or browsers. When all else fails, Gap's customer service team is there to help.
